check: SELECT sv.system_id, sv.cve_id, sv.status, sv.assignee_id, sv.due_date FROM system_vulnerabilities sv WHERE sv.system_id = %(system_id)s AND sv.cve_id = %(cve_id)s

SELECT h.old_status, h.new_status, h.changed_by FROM patch_history h JOIN system_vulnerabilities sv ON sv.sv_id = h.sv_id WHERE sv.system_id = %(system_id)s AND sv.cve_id = %(cve_id)s ORDER BY h.history_id
